description: This file defines a wizard interface for paying and reconciling invoices in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form layouts, business logic for payment processing, and state transitions.

classes.name: wizard_pay_invoice
classes.description: Wizard interface class for paying and reconciling invoices with multiple states and forms.

methods.name: _pay_and_reconcile
methods.description: Handles the payment and reconciliation process, including currency conversions and validation.

methods.name: _wo_check
methods.description: Performs checks for write-off or addendum based on invoice and payment amounts.

methods.name: _get_value_addendum
methods.description: Provides default values for the addendum form, specifically the comment.

methods.name: _get_period
methods.description: Determines the accounting period for the invoice, ensuring it is not in draft, proforma, or canceled state.
